lead: Two slices over the same file cannot be split into two commits, so commit the first before starting the second.
body: `session.py --wrap` stages a `## commit:` by *pathspec*, so if two slices both edit `routes.rs` the first section sweeps both slices' changes and the second commits nothing — and a "next group" shares a file set by definition, so this is the normal case. Either accept one commit with two clauses, which house style allows, or `git commit` slice 1 by hand once its own crate's tests are green and let the wrap commit the rest.
